sentences.text: The documents do not state the monthly EMI for a loan of Rs 3,200,000 at 8.75% per year over 300 months, so a calculation is needed.
The documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment payable by the borrower towards interest and principal.
The KFS shows EMI amount ₹21,696 for a ₹25,00,000 home loan with 240 monthly instalments, not for a loan of Rs 3,200,000 over 300 months.
